# Data

- DAT-017 (must): Always inspect the generated EF Core migrations and test them before applying them to a production database, and you should always review a generated migration's code to make sure it corresponds to the desired change. Don't delete a migration that has been applied to a shared, test, or production database; usually keep it in the project and add a new corrective migration. To detect, before deployment, a model that has pending changes compared to the last migration, use dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes in the CI/CD pipeline.
